title: Something Was Sitting On His Shoulder | Animated Horror Short Film
description:
Arjun moves into a cheap rented house and sleeps straight through his first night. Since then, his right shoulder feels heavy, as if somebody is leaning on him. Nobody notices anything... until his best friend Rohan looks closely at the office Diwali photo.

An original animated horror short film by CreepyCartoonTales. Watch till the end, and tell us in the comments: would you have told Arjun?
